title: 2 Samuel Bible Quiz - Chapter 11
description: Ten questions on 2 Samuel 11: David and Bathsheba, Uriah's loyalty, and the letter that sent him to his death.

questions.text: Where did David stay while Joab and all Israel besieged Rabbah?
questions.explanation: David sent Joab and all Israel, and they besieged Rabbah, but David stayed at Jerusalem.

questions.text: From where did David see a woman bathing?
questions.explanation: At evening David walked on the roof of the king's house, and from the roof he saw a woman bathing.

answers.text: From the roof of the king's house
From the window of the tabernacle
From the top of the city wall

questions.text: Whose daughter was Bathsheba, according to the report David received?
questions.explanation: David was told, "Isn't this Bathsheba, the daughter of Eliam, Uriah the Hittite's wife?"

questions.text: Where did Uriah sleep instead of going down to his house?
questions.explanation: Uriah slept at the door of the king's house with all the servants of his lord, and didn't go down to his house.

answers.text: In the house of Joab his captain
At the door of the king's house
In the courts with the priests
At an inn outside the city gate

questions.text: According to Uriah, who were staying in tents?
questions.explanation: Uriah said, "The ark, Israel, and Judah, are staying in tents."

questions.text: By whose hand did David send his letter to Joab?
questions.explanation: In the morning David wrote a letter to Joab and sent it by the hand of Uriah.

answers.text: By the hand of a Cushite
By the hand of Uriah himself

questions.text: What did David write in the letter to Joab?
questions.explanation: He wrote, "Send Uriah to the forefront of the hottest battle, and retreat from him, that he may be struck, and die."

answers.text: To send Uriah home to his wife in peace
To put Uriah in the hottest battle and retreat
To make Uriah captain over the army
To keep Uriah safe in the camp

questions.text: Which man might the king ask about, who was killed when a woman cast an upper millstone on him from the wall?
questions.explanation: The messenger was told the king might ask, "Who struck Abimelech the son of Jerubbesheth? Didn't a woman cast an upper millstone on him from the wall?"

questions.text: What did David tell the messenger to say to Joab?
questions.explanation: David said, "Don't let this thing displease you, for the sword devours one as well as another."

answers.text: That Joab must come home at once
That Uriah should be buried with honor
That the sword devours one as well as another

questions.text: How did Yahweh view what David had done?
questions.explanation: After she became David's wife and bore him a son, the text says the thing David had done displeased Yahweh.
